Riddle Road comes in at the top left (its west line is in the gutter; centre taken ~186 px west of the east line, matching the pipe), bends SSE, and at Deckebach turns due east (three-way junction; Riddle's diagonal and east legs and Deckebach's south leg all meet where the water pipes meet). Riddle continues east across Marshall onto 285 (cross). The Riddle/Foulke T is also on sheet 283 (overlap at the gutter). Foulke: the west piece (25') runs from Riddle to x~1683; a 25' piece with no name printed runs from x~4455 east into Marshall; it lies on the same straight line as the west piece (centre within ~10 px of Foulke's extended centreline) and is named Foulke Street here; nothing is drawn between them except the rear line of the Riddle lots. Marshall Avenue (the northern, not-improved Marshall) comes in diagonally at the top (no crossings until its bend) and runs due south along the right edge, widening from 40' to 50' at Riddle. Marshall continues south across Probasco (sheet 285 shows both its lines running on below Probasco), so Marshall/Probasco is a cross; its east line here is a thin line near the gutter (x~6292). Probasco continues west of Deckebach to the left drawing edge at x~467 (lines just stop; the rest is drawn on 283/276), so Deckebach/Probasco is a cross. The long single line across block 2 at the top left is a property line.
